root.label: Global shipping authorities warn of maritime trade breakdown

events.label: Global shipping authorities warn of maritime trade breakdown

slots.name: sea trade share
slots.sentence: In a joint statement issued Tuesday, the Consultative Shipping Group (CSG) — an informal cooperation between the maritime bodies of 18 shipping nations across the globe — noted that more than 80% of global trade is transported by sea.

slots.name: shadow fleet ships
slots.sentence: They warned that an increasing number of vessels were now engaging in operations that circumvent sanctions, with "an unregulated shadow fleet … of hundreds of ships operating outside of standard insurance, safety and transparency frameworks" further fragmenting global supply chains.
